stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He also told them of men who ate human flesh and of strange race of people whole heads were under their shoulders. (b) He was a brave shoulder who had risen to become a general. (c) Brabanto, a rich senator of Venice, had only one daughter named Desdemonia who was so beautiful that many young men of the best families wished to marry her. (d) He told them of deserts, caves and mountains high enough to touch the sky. (e) Brabanto often invited Othello to his house where he and his daughter listened in wonder to Othellow as he spoke about his adventures. (f) He refused them all because she loved Othello, a noble Moor from North Africa. (g) Hearing it, she had to weep and she never became tried of listening to it.
